name: When should I consider replacing my door frame?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your door frame if you notice signs of damage such as rot, cracks, warping, or insect infestation. A damaged frame can compromise the security and energy efficiency of your home. Additionally, if you are upgrading to a new door that doesn't fit your existing frame, or if you're experiencing drafts around the door, a frame replacement may be necessary. Replacing a damaged frame ensures proper door function and can improve your home's insulation.
